title: Survey the Crash
speaker: ECHO
story: Hull breach contained. Pilot vitals stable. I am ECHO, your suit intelligence. We need material. Start with the dark basalt around the pod.
text: Mine 8 Basalt with your mining laser (hold MINE).

title: Ferrite Hunter
speaker: ECHO
story: Rust-coloured specks in the rock are ferrite. Iron, roughly. Everything we build starts with it.
text: Collect 4 Ferrite Chunks from ferrite ore.

title: First Fabrication
speaker: ECHO
story: With basalt and ferrite I can print a Fabricator. It is the heart of any colony.
text: Craft a Fabricator (BAG → Fabricate) and place it.

title: A Distress Beacon
speaker: ECHO
story: I am picking up a human beacon to the north-east. Haven Outpost. Other survivors! Follow the marker.
text: Find Haven Outpost and talk to Ossa the trader (aim at her, tap USE).

title: Arc Smelter
speaker: Rook
story: Raw ore won't get you far. Build a smelter, I'll show you how to melt cuprite and ferrite down.
text: Collect Cuprite (green ore), craft an Arc Smelter at the Fabricator and place it.

title: Metallurgy
speaker: Rook
story: Two chunks in, one ingot out. You can also load ore into the smelter and let it work by itself.
text: Smelt 4 Ferrite Ingots (stand near the smelter and craft).

title: Circuitry
speaker: Rook
story: Copper plus a lumen shard makes a circuit board. Circuits make everything smart.
text: Craft 2 Circuit Boards.

title: Defend Yourself
speaker: Vela
story: The Umbral Stalkers hunt by night. They are beautiful. They will also eat you. Arm yourself.
text: Craft a Plasma Pistol.

title: Xenobiology
speaker: Vela
story: Bring down a few creatures. I need to understand their biology, and you need the meat.
text: Defeat 3 creatures.

title: Harness the Sun
speaker: Rook
story: A colony that dies at sunset isn't a colony. Solar panels by day, battery banks by night.
text: Build a Battery Bank (and a Solar Panel to charge it).

title: Companion
speaker: Vela
story: Mossbacks bond for life. Offer one a Bio Lure and it will guard you.
text: Use a Bio Lure on a Mossback to tame it.

title: Green Thumb
speaker: Vela
story: We can't live on rations forever. A hydroponic tray grows real food while powered.
text: Place a Hydroponic Tray.

title: Ruin Delver
speaker: ECHO
story: The glyph structures predate any known civilisation by millions of years. Their caches may hold answers. And guardians.
text: Find precursor ruins and break open an Ancient Cache.

title: Assembly Line
speaker: Rook
story: Titanium, alloys, drones. For that you need an Assembler.
text: Craft and place an Assembler.

title: Wheels
speaker: Rook
story: Walking is for tourists. Build yourself a rover.
text: Craft a Rover Deploy Kit and deploy it (USE).

title: Automation
speaker: Rook
story: Let the drones do the digging. A Miner Bay sends one out to fetch ore for you.
text: Place a Drone Miner Bay.

title: Launch Pad
speaker: ECHO
story: The beacon was never a rescue call. It was a map. Six worlds, and something at the edge of the system. We need a ship.
text: Place a Launch Pad, then install a hull, engine and nav computer (USE on the pad).

title: First Jump
speaker: ECHO
story: Plotting course. Brace for atmospheric exit.
text: Fly to another world: Kryos, Aridus or the Kessler Belt.

title: Refinery
speaker: ECHO
story: Uranite, cobalt and void shards need a refinery. This is where the real technology begins.
text: Craft and place a Refinery.

title: Fusion
speaker: ECHO
story: A fusion core. Enough power to light a city, or push a ship through a volcanic atmosphere.
text: Refine a Fusion Core.

title: Into the Fire
speaker: ECHO
story: Pyrrhos. Magma seas and radioactive seams. Thermal lining recommended.
text: Upgrade to a Fusion Engine and land on Pyrrhos.

title: The Anomaly
speaker: ECHO
story: Nullara does not appear on any chart I have. Gravity there is wrong. The signal is coming from its heart.
text: Reach Nullara (engine tier 3) and defeat the Void Guardian near X 160 Z 160.

title: Terraformer
speaker: Vela
story: The Guardian's heart can drive a terraformer. We could give these worlds air, water, life. Let's begin.
text: Build and power a Terraformer on any world.

title: Breathe
speaker: Vela
story: Feed it catalysts. Watch the sky change.
text: Raise a planet's atmosphere to 100%.

title: Gaia
speaker: ECHO
story: Pilot. Look outside. Grass. You did this. Now do it again, everywhere.
text: Bring a world to 100% life.
